Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: Must provide proof of English proficiency (TOEFL or IELTS) if English is not your first language. A minimum TOEFL score of 550 (PBT), 213 (CBT), or 79 (iBT) is required.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Open to women who are not U.S. citizens or permanent residents. Must intend to return to their home country to pursue a professional career.

usa.Application Deadline: The application deadline is typically November 15.
usa.Value/Inclusions: Master's/First Professional Degree: USD 20,000. Doctoral: USD 25,000. Postdoctoral: USD 50,000. The funds can be used for educational expenses, living costs, and dependent child care.
usa.Application Process: Complete the online application form. Submit all required documents electronically.

usa.Scholarship Name: Tata Scholarship for Students from India
usa.Host Country and University: USA, Cornell University.

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Must be admitted to an undergraduate program at Cornell University.
Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: Must meet Cornell's admission requirements, which typically include SAT or ACT scores (though policies may be test-optional) and English proficiency scores (TOEFL/IELTS).
Eligibility Criteria.Field of Study: Priority is given to students in the College of Architecture, Art, and Planning; the College of Engineering; and programs in the College of Agriculture and Life Sciences and the SC Johnson College of Business.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Must be a citizen of India and have attended secondary school in India. Must demonstrate financial need.

usa.Application Deadline: Aligns with Cornell's admission deadlines (Early Decision in November, Regular Decision in January). You must complete the CSS Profile for financial aid.
usa.Value/Inclusions: A full scholarship that covers the estimated cost of attendance, including tuition, fees, living expenses, and travel for the duration of the undergraduate program (up to eight semesters).
usa.Application Process: Apply for admission to Cornell University through the Common App. Apply for financial aid by submitting the CSS Profile and other required financial documents. Eligible Indian students are automatically considered.

usa.Host Country and University: USA, Stanford Graduate School of Business (GSB).

Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: A GMAT or GRE score is required for admission to the MBA program.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Open to Indian citizens living in India who demonstrate financial need. Fellows are required to return to India within two years of completing their MBA studies and work for an Indian organization.

usa.Application Deadline: The fellowship application deadline is typically in late May, well before the MBA application rounds.
usa.Value/Inclusions: Covers the full cost of tuition and associated fees for the two-year Stanford MBA program (approximately USD 175,000).
usa.Application Process: Apply for the fellowship online. This is the first step. Up to 50 finalists are selected and asked to complete the standard Stanford MBA application. Up to five fellows are chosen from the finalists. Stanford GSB will pay the MBA application fees for all finalists.

usa.Scholarship Name: University of Chicago International Financial Aid / Merit Scholarships
usa.Host Country and University: USA, University of Chicago.

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Must demonstrate outstanding academic and extracurricular achievement.
Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: UChicago is test-optional, but international students may submit SAT, ACT, or other scores to demonstrate academic readiness. English proficiency scores are required.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Open to all international students. Aid can be either need-based or merit-based.

usa.Application Deadline: Aligns with the university's admission deadlines (Early Action/Decision in November, Regular Decision in January).
usa.Value/Inclusions: Can range from partial tuition waivers to full-ride scholarships that cover tuition, fees, and living expenses. The university guarantees free tuition for families with incomes under $125,000.
usa.Application Process: Apply for admission to the University of Chicago via the Common App or Coalition Application. Indicate on the application that you are applying for financial aid. Submit the International Student Financial Aid Application (ISFAA) or the CSS Profile. No separate application is needed for merit scholarships; all applicants are automatically considered.

usa.Scholarship Name: New York University (NYU) Wagner Merit-Based Scholarships
usa.Host Country and University: USA, New York University Robert F. Wagner Graduate School of Public Service.

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Based on the strength of the application, including academic performance.
Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: GRE/GMAT scores are optional for most programs. English proficiency scores are required for non-native speakers.
Eligibility Criteria.Field of Study: Master of Public Administration (MPA), Master of Urban Planning (MUP), Master of Health Administration (MHA).
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Open to all admitted students, including internationals.

usa.Application Deadline: No separate application is needed. Applicants should apply for admission by the program's priority deadline, typically in early December.
usa.Value/Inclusions: Varies. Awards range from partial to full tuition scholarships. For example, the Dean's Scholarship is a full-tuition award. Other awards may range from USD 20,000 to USD 50,000.
usa.Application Process: Apply for admission to an eligible Master's program at NYU Wagner. All admitted students are automatically considered for all merit-based scholarships.

usa.Scholarship Name: American University Emerging Global Leader Scholarship
usa.Host Country and University: USA, American University, Washington D.C.

Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: SAT/ACT scores are not required. English proficiency test scores are required (e.g., TOEFL iBT 95+, IELTS 7.0+).
Eligibility Criteria.Other: For international students who have overcome adversity and are from underrepresented backgrounds. Must demonstrate a commitment to public service and leadership. Must intend to return to their home country.

usa.Application Deadline: The scholarship application deadline is December 15.
usa.Value/Inclusions: Covers full tuition, fees, room, and board. It is renewable for four years of study. It does not cover health insurance, books, or travel expenses.
usa.Application Process: Apply for admission to American University via the Common Application. Complete and submit the separate AU EGLS application form online.

usa.Scholarship Name: University of Southern California (USC) Merit Scholarships
usa.Host Country and University: USA, University of Southern California.

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Based on exceptional academic talent, leadership, and community service.
Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: USC is test-optional. English proficiency scores are required.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Open to all students, including international students.

usa.Application Deadline: To be considered for most merit scholarships, you must apply for admission by the early action deadline of November 1.
usa.Value/Inclusions: Varies by award. Trustee Scholarship: Full tuition. Presidential Scholarship: Half tuition. Deans Scholarship: Quarter tuition. These are renewable for four years.
usa.Application Process: Apply for admission to USC using the Common Application by the November 1 deadline. All students who apply by this deadline are automatically considered for these scholarships. Finalists for the top scholarships are invited for an interview.

usa.Host Country and University: USA, Boston University.

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Must demonstrate exceptional academic achievement in high school.
Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: While BU is test-optional, strong SAT/ACT scores can support an application. English proficiency test scores (TOEFL/IELTS) are required for international students.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Open to all students, including internationals, who demonstrate excellence beyond academics, such as leadership and community involvement.

usa.Application Deadline: To be considered, students must apply for admission by December 1.
usa.Value/Inclusions: USD 25,000 per year. The scholarship is renewable for up to four years of undergraduate study.
usa.Application Process: Apply for admission to Boston University using the Common Application. No separate scholarship application is required. All students who apply for admission by the deadline are automatically considered.

usa.Host Country and University: USA, Clark University.

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Must have a strong high school record and demonstrate leadership potential.
Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: Clark is test-optional. English proficiency test scores are required.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Must be a first-year applicant who has attended school overseas for at least four years. A demonstrated commitment to making a difference in the world is essential.

usa.Application Deadline: The deadline to apply for the Global Scholars Program is typically November 15 for Early Action/Decision and February 1 for Regular Decision.
usa.Value/Inclusions: If admitted to the program, students receive a scholarship of USD 15,000 to USD 25,000 per year for four years. If the student's financial need is greater than the scholarship amount, they may be eligible for additional need-based financial aid. Also includes a guaranteed USD 2,500 taxable stipend for an approved internship or research project.
usa.Application Process: Apply for admission to Clark University. Within the application, there is a section to indicate interest in the Global Scholars Program, which requires an additional short essay.

usa.Host Country and University: USA, Emory University.

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Must have an outstanding academic record.
Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: Emory is test-optional. English proficiency scores are required.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Must demonstrate qualities of forceful and unselfish character, intellectual and personal vigor, and outstanding leadership potential.

usa.Application Deadline: Applicants must submit their application for admission and all required materials by November 15.
usa.Value/Inclusions: Varies from partial to full tuition scholarships. The most prestigious award, the Robert W. Woodruff Scholarship, is a full-ride scholarship covering tuition, fees, room, and board. All scholars receive stipends for research, study abroad, and internships.
usa.Application Process: Apply for admission to Emory University or Oxford College at Emory using the Common Application. Indicate your interest in the Emory University Scholars Program on the admission application. You must answer an additional essay prompt. All applicants who apply by the deadline are considered.

usa.Scholarship Name: University of Michigan Rackham Merit Fellowship (RMF)
usa.Host Country and University: USA, University of Michigan.
usa.Level of Study: Doctoral (PhD) and Master of Fine Arts (MFA).

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Must be admitted to a Rackham graduate program.
Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: Must meet the requirements of the specific graduate program (e.g., GRE).
Eligibility Criteria.Field of Study: Most PhD and MFA programs at the University of Michigan.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Open to newly admitted students, including internationals, who have a background and experiences that will contribute to a diverse and inclusive scholarly environment.

usa.Application Deadline: No separate application is needed. Students are nominated by their graduate program after being admitted. The deadline to apply for the graduate program is typically in early December.
usa.Value/Inclusions: Provides tuition, fees, a living stipend (over USD 32,000 per year), and health insurance for up to five years of study.
usa.Application Process: Apply for admission to an eligible PhD or MFA program at the University of Michigan. The graduate program's admissions committee will nominate eligible candidates for the fellowship.

usa.Host Country and University: USA or Canada, at any accredited university.

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Must be qualified for admission to full-time graduate study.
Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: Must meet the language requirements of the chosen university.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: For women from countries other than the U.S. and Canada. Must have a full year of coursework remaining. Must promise to return to their home country within 60 days of completing their degree.

usa.Application Deadline: Eligibility must be established between September 15 and December 15. The final application is due by January 31.
usa.Value/Inclusions: A one-time award of up to USD 12,500. It is not intended to cover all academic or personal expenses.
usa.Application Process: Request an eligibility form from the P.E.O. website. If deemed eligible, you will be sent the full application materials. Submit the completed application.

usa.Host Country and University: USA, University of Miami.

Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: Test scores are considered if submitted.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Must demonstrate leadership, talent, and community service.

usa.Application Deadline: Must apply for Early Action admission by November 1.
usa.Value/Inclusions: A full-ride scholarship that covers tuition, fees, room and board, health insurance, a textbook allowance, a laptop allowance, and access to a USD 12,000 enrichment fund for study abroad, research, internships, etc.
usa.Application Process: Apply for admission to the University of Miami using the Common Application by the Early Action deadline. All Early Action applicants are automatically considered. Semifinalists are contacted and asked to submit a short essay. Finalists are invited to an on-campus event.

usa.Scholarship Name: Brandeis University Wien International Scholarship Program (WISP)
usa.Host Country and University: USA, Brandeis University.

Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: Brandeis is test-optional. English proficiency scores are required.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Open to international students with a strong record of academic achievement and a history of community involvement. Must demonstrate financial need.

usa.Application Deadline: You must apply for admission and financial aid by January 2.
usa.Value/Inclusions: Varies based on financial need. Can cover up to the full cost of attendance (tuition, room, board, and fees).
usa.Application Process: Apply for admission to Brandeis University via the Common Application. Submit the CSS Profile to apply for financial aid. All international students applying for aid are automatically considered for the Wien Scholarship.

usa.Scholarship Name: Georgia Institute of Technology (Georgia Tech) Merit Scholarships
usa.Host Country and University: USA, Georgia Institute of Technology.

Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: Standardized test scores are required for admission at Georgia Tech.
Eligibility Criteria.Field of Study: Primarily Engineering, Computing, Sciences, Business, Design, and Liberal Arts.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: While most financial aid is reserved for U.S. citizens, Georgia Tech offers a limited number of merit-based scholarships to international students.

usa.Application Deadline: Must apply for Early Action admission by October 15 for maximum scholarship consideration.
usa.Value/Inclusions: Varies. Awards can range from a few thousand dollars to covering the full cost of out-of-state tuition.
usa.Application Process: Apply for admission to Georgia Tech using the Common Application. Complete the scholarship application within the admission application. This includes several short essays.

usa.Scholarship Name: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (UIUC) Graduate College Fellowships
usa.Host Country and University: USA, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign.

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Exceptional academic record and research potential.
Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: Must meet the requirements of the specific graduate program (e.g., GRE).
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Open to newly admitted graduate students.

usa.Application Deadline: No direct application. Students are nominated by their admitting department. Graduate program application deadlines are typically in December or early January.
usa.Value/Inclusions: Varies by award. The Graduate College Fellowship, for example, provides a stipend of USD 25,000 for one year, plus a full tuition and fee waiver.
usa.Application Process: Apply for admission to a graduate program at UIUC. The department's admissions committee will select and nominate top applicants for various fellowships.

usa.Scholarship Name: The Hubert H. Humphrey Fellowship Program
usa.Host Country and University: USA, at various participating U.S. universities.

Eligibility Criteria.Field of Study: Various fields related to public service, sustainable development, public health, education, and more.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: For experienced mid-career professionals from designated countries, including India. Must have a minimum of five years of full-time professional experience.

usa.Application Deadline: Varies by country. In India, it is managed by USIEF and the deadline is typically in mid-June.
usa.Value/Inclusions: A fully-funded program that covers tuition and fees at the host university, a living allowance, accident and sickness coverage, a book allowance, and funding for professional activities, including travel.
usa.Application Process: Apply through the U.S. Embassy (Public Affairs Section) or Binational Fulbright Commission (USIEF in India) in your home country. National selection committees nominate candidates for final review by the J. William Fulbright Foreign Scholarship Board.

usa.Scholarship Name: University of Wisconsin-Madison (UWM) Graduate School Fellowships
usa.Host Country and University: USA, University of Wisconsin-Madison.

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Must have an excellent academic record and be admitted to a graduate program.
Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: Must meet the requirements of the specific graduate program (e.g., GRE).
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Open to new and continuing graduate students, including internationals.

usa.Application Deadline: No direct application. Students are nominated by their graduate program. Deadlines to apply for graduate programs are typically from December to January.
usa.Value/Inclusions: Varies. For example, the University-Wide Fellowship provides a stipend of approximately USD 26,000 per year, a full tuition waiver, and eligibility for health insurance benefits.
usa.Application Process: Apply for admission to a graduate program at the University of Wisconsin-Madison. Your program will automatically consider you for nomination for various Graduate School fellowships based on the strength of your admission application.

Required Documents.A complete graduate program application: including a statement of purpose, transcripts, and letters of recommendation.

usa.Host Country and University: USA, University of Pennsylvania.

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Outstanding academic profile suitable for a top-tier PhD program.
Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: GRE scores are required by many, but not all, programs.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: UPenn's PhD programs are fully funded for all admitted students, including internationals.

usa.Application Deadline: Varies by program, but most PhD application deadlines are in early to mid-December.
usa.Value/Inclusions: A full funding package that includes a multi-year studentship covering tuition, fees, health insurance, and a living stipend. Stipends are competitive (e.g., often USD 38,000+ per year).
usa.Application Process: Apply for admission to a PhD program at the University of Pennsylvania. All students who are offered admission to a PhD program are automatically offered a full funding package.

All documents required for PhD admission.Writing Sample: (for many humanities and social science programs).

usa.Scholarship Name: Washington University in St. Louis (WashU) Danforth Scholars Program
usa.Host Country and University: USA, Washington University in St. Louis.

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Must be a top academic performer.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: For students with a history of leadership, service, and a strong commitment to the community. A nomination is required.

usa.Application Deadline: You must be nominated by a school official by November 1, and you must submit your admission application by January 3.
usa.Value/Inclusions: Can be a full-tuition or partial-tuition scholarship, renewable each year for four years. Also includes access to a community of scholars and special programming.
usa.Application Process: First, you must receive a nomination from a high school counselor or teacher. Once nominated, you must apply for admission to Washington University in St. Louis. You will then be prompted to submit a separate application for the Danforth Scholars Program.

usa.Host Country and University: USA, Duke University.

Eligibility Criteria.Other: Open to non-U.S. citizens who demonstrate financial need. Intended for students with strong academic and leadership potential who will become catalysts for change in their home communities.

usa.Application Deadline: You must apply for admission by the Regular Decision deadline of January 2 and submit the CSS Profile for financial aid by February 1.
usa.Value/Inclusions: A full scholarship that covers tuition, room, board, and mandatory fees for four years. Also includes funding for three summers of research, unpaid internships, or other growth experiences.
usa.Application Process: Apply for admission to Duke University. Apply for need-based financial aid by submitting the CSS Profile. No separate scholarship application is needed. The admissions and financial aid offices will identify and select potential Karsh Scholars from the international applicant pool.

usa.Scholarship Name: Michigan State University (MSU) International Tuition Grant
usa.Host Country and University: USA, Michigan State University.

Eligibility Criteria.Other: Must be an international student admitted to MSU.

usa.Application Deadline: No separate application is required. Students are automatically considered upon admission.
usa.Value/Inclusions: Varies annually. Can range from USD 18,000 to USD 25,000 per year. It is renewable for eight semesters.
usa.Application Process: Apply for admission to Michigan State University. You are automatically considered for the grant based on your academic record and the information provided in your admission application.

usa.Scholarship Name: University of Oregon International Student Scholarships
usa.Host Country and University: USA, University of Oregon.

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Must have a minimum GPA of 3.0.
Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: Not required for scholarship, but needed for admission.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Open to international students who demonstrate financial need and academic merit.

usa.Application Deadline: January 15 for the International Cultural Service Program (ICSP) and February 15 for most other scholarships.
usa.Value/Inclusions: Varies. ICSP Scholarship: A partial tuition waiver of USD 7,500 to USD 30,000 per year. Recipients must complete 80 hours of cultural service per year. International Dean's Excellence Award (IDEA): USD 10,000 per year.
usa.Application Process: Apply for admission to the University of Oregon. Complete the separate online scholarship application.

usa.Scholarship Name: Illinois Wesleyan University (IWU) International Student Scholarships
usa.Host Country and University: USA, Illinois Wesleyan University.

Eligibility Criteria.Other: Open to international students who demonstrate strong academic achievement and talents in fine arts or other areas.

usa.Application Deadline: November 15 for Early Action. Regular decision applications are also considered.
usa.Value/Inclusions: Merit-based scholarships range from USD 16,000 to USD 30,000 per year. President's Scholarships can be full-tuition.
usa.Application Process: Apply for admission to Illinois Wesleyan University. All applicants are automatically considered for merit scholarships. A separate application for financial aid (CSS Profile or IWU Financial Aid form) is required to determine need-based aid.

usa.Host Country and University: USA, at any ABET-accredited university.

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Must be enrolled in an ABET-accredited engineering, computing, or technology program.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: For women pursuing degrees in engineering. Open to all nationalities.

usa.Application Deadline: Varies. The deadline for upperclassmen (sophomores through graduate students) is typically February 1. The deadline for incoming freshmen is in March.
usa.Value/Inclusions: The value ranges from USD 1,000 to over USD 20,000.
usa.Application Process: Create an account and apply through the SWE online scholarship portal. A single application makes you eligible for multiple scholarships.

usa.Host Country and University: USA or Canada, at any university.

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Must be pursuing a degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a closely related technical field.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Must have a visible or invisible disability (as defined by the WHO). Must exemplify leadership and demonstrate a passion for computer science.

usa.Application Deadline: The application deadline is typically in early December.
usa.Value/Inclusions: USD 10,000 (for students in the US) or CAD 5,000 (for students in Canada). Also includes an invitation to attend the annual Google Scholars' Retreat.
usa.Application Process: Apply through the Lime Connect website. The application includes general information, essays, and transcripts.

usa.Scholarship Name: The Aga Khan Foundation International Scholarship Programme
usa.Host Country and University: USA, at select universities like Harvard, MIT, Princeton, and Columbia.

Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: As required by the host university.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: For citizens of countries where AKF has an office, including India. Preference is given to students under 30 years of age. Based on demonstrated financial need.

usa.Application Deadline: Applications are handled by local AKF offices in India, with a deadline typically on March 31.
usa.Value/Inclusions: A 50% grant and 50% loan that covers tuition fees and living expenses.
usa.Application Process: Obtain an application form from the Aga Khan Foundation office in India. Submit the completed application locally.

usa.Scholarship Name: University of Minnesota (UMN) Global Excellence Scholarship
usa.Host Country and University: USA, University of Minnesota, Twin Cities.

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Based on a holistic review of the admission application, with strong academic preparation being key.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Must be an international student admitted to the university.

usa.Application Deadline: No separate application is needed. Students must apply for admission by the Early Action deadline of November 1.
usa.Value/Inclusions: USD 25,000 per year, renewable for up to four years.
usa.Application Process: Apply for admission to the University of Minnesota using the Common Application. All international students who apply by the November 1 deadline are automatically considered for the scholarship.

usa.Host Country and University: USA, Vanderbilt University.

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Must demonstrate exceptional academic accomplishment and intellectual curiosity.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Must show strong leadership and a commitment to service.

usa.Application Deadline: The scholarship application deadline is December 1.
usa.Value/Inclusions: Varies. The three main merit awards (Ingram, Cornelius Vanderbilt, and Chancellor's) provide full tuition support plus a summer stipend for a research or service project.
usa.Application Process: Apply for admission to Vanderbilt University via the Common Application. After applying for admission, you will receive access to your MyAppVU portal, where you can apply for the signature merit scholarships through a separate application.

usa.Scholarship Name: New York University (NYU) Global Pathways Scholarship
usa.Host Country and University: USA, New York University.

Eligibility Criteria.Other: Must be an international student with demonstrated financial need.

usa.Application Deadline: You must apply for admission and financial aid by the relevant deadline (Early Decision in November, Regular Decision in January).
usa.Value/Inclusions: Varies based on financial need. NYU meets 100% of demonstrated financial need for all admitted students, including internationals. Awards can range from small grants to full-tuition scholarships.
usa.Application Process: Apply for admission to NYU via the Common Application. Submit the CSS Profile to apply for need-based financial aid. All international applicants who apply for financial aid are automatically considered.

usa.Scholarship Name: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill (UNC) Morehead-Cain Scholarship
usa.Host Country and University: USA, University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill.

Eligibility Criteria.Other: One of the most prestigious merit scholarships in the US. Based on four criteria: leadership, moral force of character, physical vigor, and scholarship.

usa.Application Deadline: The application deadline is October 15. International students must be nominated by their high school.
usa.Value/Inclusions: A four-year, fully-funded educational experience. It covers full tuition, student fees, housing, meals, a laptop, and four summer enrichment programs.
usa.Application Process: International students must be nominated by their high school (if it is a registered nominating school) or apply through the direct application process. Complete the Morehead-Cain application. Finalists are invited to UNC for interviews. You must also apply for admission to UNC Chapel Hill.

usa.Host Country and University: USA, Rice University.

Eligibility Criteria.Other: Must show exemplary leadership and personal qualities.

usa.Application Deadline: No separate application is needed. Students must apply for admission by the deadline (November 1 for Early Decision, January 4 for Regular Decision).
usa.Value/Inclusions: All merit scholarships are at least half-tuition. The most prestigious awards cover full tuition. All are renewable for four years.
usa.Application Process: Apply for admission to Rice University using the Common Application or Coalition Application. All applicants are automatically considered for merit scholarships based on the information in their admission application.

usa.Scholarship Name: University of California, Berkeley (UCB) Graduate Division Fellowships
usa.Host Country and University: USA, University of California, Berkeley.

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Excellent academic record and research potential.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Many fellowships are available to all students, including internationals.

usa.Application Deadline: No separate application. You must apply for admission to a graduate program by your program's deadline, which is typically in early December.
usa.Value/Inclusions: Varies widely. The Berkeley Fellowship for Graduate Study, a top multi-year award, provides a stipend of USD 34,000, plus full tuition and fees.
usa.Application Process: Apply for admission to a graduate program at UC Berkeley. On the application, check the box to be considered for all departmental and university fellowships. Your department will nominate top candidates.

Required Documents.A complete graduate admission applicatio: including statements of purpose, transcripts, and letters of recommendation.

usa.Scholarship Name: University of Texas at Austin (UT Austin) International Student Scholarships
usa.Host Country and University: USA, University of Texas at Austin.

Eligibility Criteria.Other: Must be an international student. Most scholarships are awarded by individual departments. A key benefit is that receiving a competitive scholarship of at least $1,000 can make an international student eligible for in-state tuition rates.

usa.Application Deadline: Varies by department. You should inquire with your specific department's coordinator.
usa.Value/Inclusions: Varies from USD 500 to several thousand dollars. The main value is often the accompanying waiver of out-of-state tuition, which can save a student over USD 20,000 per year.
usa.Application Process: Apply for admission to UT Austin. Contact your admitting department to learn about their scholarship application process. Some are automatic; others require a separate form.

usa.Scholarship Name: Wesleyan University Freeman Asian Scholars Program
usa.Host Country and University: USA, Wesleyan University.

Eligibility Criteria.Other: For citizens of 11 Asian countries, including India. Must demonstrate financial need.

usa.Value/Inclusions: A full scholarship that covers the cost of tuition and fees for four years.
usa.Application Process: Apply for admission to Wesleyan University. Complete the Freeman Asian Scholars Program application, available on the university's portal. You must also apply for financial aid by submitting the CSS Profile.

usa.Host Country and University: USA, University of Hawai‘i at Mānoa.

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Must be admitted to a graduate program at the University of Hawai‘i.
Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: GRE/GMAT scores as required by the graduate program.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: For citizens of countries in the Asia-Pacific region, including India. Must have a strong commitment to the Asia-Pacific region.

usa.Value/Inclusions: Provides funding for up to 24 months, including tuition and fees, a stipend for living expenses, health insurance, and subsidized housing in an East-West Center residence hall.
usa.Application Process: Apply simultaneously to the East-West Center for the fellowship and to the University of Hawai‘i for admission to a graduate program. The applications are separate but reviewed concurrently.

usa.Host Country and University: USA, University of Nebraska-Lincoln.

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Based on a holistic review, with emphasis on academic achievement.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Open to all international undergraduate applicants.

usa.Application Deadline: No separate application needed. Students should apply for admission by February 1.
usa.Value/Inclusions: Varies. The Global Ambassador Scholarship is valued at USD 15,000 per year. The Global Scholar Scholarship is valued at USD 10,000 per year.
usa.Application Process: Apply for admission to the University of Nebraska-Lincoln. You are automatically considered for these scholarships based on your admission application.

usa.Scholarship Name: Columbia University School of International and Public Affairs (SIPA) Fellowships
usa.Host Country and University: USA, Columbia University SIPA.

Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: GRE/GMAT is optional for most programs.
Eligibility Criteria.Field of Study: Master of International Affairs (MIA), Master of Public Administration (MPA).
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Open to all admitted students, including internationals. Both merit-based and need-based fellowships are available.

usa.Application Deadline: You must apply for admission and fellowship consideration by the priority deadline, which is typically January 5.
usa.Value/Inclusions: Ranges from USD 5,000 to full tuition.
usa.Application Process: Apply for admission to a SIPA Master's program. Complete the fellowship and financial aid section within the admission application.

usa.Scholarship Name: Johns Hopkins University (JHU) Financial Aid for International Students
usa.Host Country and University: USA, Johns Hopkins University.

Eligibility Criteria.Other: JHU is need-aware for international students but meets 100% of the calculated need for all admitted students who have applied for aid.

usa.Application Deadline: You must apply for admission and financial aid by the relevant deadline (November 1 for Early Decision, January 3 for Regular Decision).

[1]
uk.Application Process: Apply directly through the Chevening online application portal. Applicants must select and apply for three eligible UK university courses alongside their Chevening application. [1] The process involves an online application, shortlisting, submission of references and education documents, and an interview in your home country.

Required Documents.Statement of Purpose (SOP): A series of four essays on leadership, networking, your proposed UK study, and your career plan.
Required Documents.Letters of Recommendation (LORs): Two letters of recommendation are required, which are submitted after being shortlisted.
Required Documents.Academic Transcripts: Required from all higher education institutions attended.
Required Documents.Proof of English proficiency (TOEFL/IELT: Required to receive an unconditional offer from your chosen university.

newzealand.Scholarship Name: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
newzealand.Host Country and University: New Zealand, at any eligible New Zealand university.

University Rankings.Note: Not applicable (multiple institutions). Key participating universities include University of Auckland (QS 2025: 68th) and University of Otago (QS 2025: 214th).

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Varies by country and chosen course. Generally requires a Bachelor's degree of a standard equivalent to a New Zealand Bachelor's degree.
Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: English proficiency is required (e.g., IELTS overall score of 6.5 and no band less than 6.0; TOEFL iBT score of 90 with a writing score of 21).
Eligibility Criteria.Field of Study: Priority is given to subjects that contribute to the development of your home country, such as Climate Change and the Environment, Disaster Risk Management, Food Security and Agriculture, Renewable Energy, and Good Governance.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Must be a citizen of an eligible country (including India). Must agree to return to your home country for a minimum of two years after completing the scholarship. Work experience in a relevant field is strongly preferred.

newzealand.Application Deadline: The application window for India typically opens in February and closes in March each year.
newzealand.Value/Inclusions: A fully-funded scholarship covering full tuition fees, a living allowance of NZ$531 per week, an establishment allowance of NZ$3000, medical insurance, travel to and from your home country, and research and thesis costs for postgraduate students.
newzealand.Application Process: Apply online through the Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships online application portal. The process involves an initial eligibility check followed by a full application if you meet the criteria.

Required Documents.Statement of Purpose (SOP): Required as part of the online application, with specific questions about your development goals and how the scholarship will help.
Required Documents.Letters of Recommendation (LORs): May be required at later stages.
Required Documents.Academic Transcripts: Required from all tertiary institutions attended.
Required Documents.CV or Resume: Details of work experience are required in the application.

newzealand.How old the scholarship is: The scholarship program, formerly known as the New Zealand Development Scholarships, has been running for several decades, evolving from the Colombo Plan initiated in the 1950s.
newzealand.Age limit: Must be 18 years or older at the time of commencing the scholarship. There is no upper age limit, but preference may be given to applicants who will have sufficient time to contribute to their country's development after their studies.

canada.Application Deadline: Early April.

canada.Application Deadline: March 1.
canada.Value/Inclusions: Ranges from CAD 1,000 to CAD 5,000.
canada.Application Process: Apply for admission to Mount Royal University. Once you have a student ID number, you can apply for scholarships through the university's awards portal. A single application makes you eligible for multiple awards.

canada.Scholarship Name: Vancouver Island University (VIU) International Entrance Scholarships

University Rankings.Note: A public university focused on teaching, not typically featured in major global research rankings.

canada.Application Process: Apply for admission to Vancouver Island University. Submit the separate scholarship application form.

canada.Application Process: Apply for admission to Wilfrid Laurier University. The award is granted automatically based on your final admission average.

canada.Application Deadline: Students are automatically considered when they are admitted.

canada.Application Deadline: Varies. There are entrance scholarships and awards for current students with deadlines each term.
canada.Value/Inclusions: Typically CAD 2,000.
canada.Application Process: Apply for admission to Niagara College. For some awards, a separate application is required after you begin your studies. Entrance awards may be automatic.

canada.Scholarship Name: University of Prince Edward Island (UPEI) Entrance Scholarships
canada.Host Country and University: Canada, University of Prince Edward Island

canada.Application Deadline: March 1 for guaranteed merit-based scholarships.

canada.Scholarship Name: University of Waterloo Faculty of Engineering Scholarships

Eligibility Criteria.Other: Based on academic results and the Admission Information Form (AIF), which assesses extracurricular involvement and suitability for engineering.

canada.Application Deadline: No separate scholarship application is needed. The AIF must be submitted by the university's deadline, usually in mid-February.
canada.Value/Inclusions: Numerous scholarships are available, ranging from CAD 1,000 to CAD 10,000. Some are renewable. For example, the President's Scholarship of Distinction for students with 95%+ averages is valued at CAD 10,000.

canada.Scholarship Name: University of Toronto Faculty of Arts & Science International Scholar Award

Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: Must meet U of T's English language requirements.
Eligibility Criteria.Field of Study: Programs within the Faculty of Arts & Science.

canada.Application Deadline: No separate application. Students are considered automatically upon admission.
canada.Value/Inclusions: The value is variable. In some cases, it can be a significant award of CAD 100,000 over four years.
canada.Application Process: Apply for admission to the Faculty of Arts & Science at the University of Toronto. The top applicants are automatically selected by the faculty's awards committee.

canada.Scholarship Name: York University Faculty of Liberal Arts & Professional Studies International Student Entrance Scholarship

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Must have an excellent admission average (typically 85%+).
Eligibility Criteria.Field of Study: Programs within the Faculty of Liberal Arts & Professional Studies.

canada.Application Deadline: Automatic consideration upon admission.
canada.Application Process: Apply for admission to a relevant program at York University. The faculty's awards committee selects recipients from the pool of admitted students.

canada.Scholarship Name: McGill University Faculty of Engineering MEDA Scholarships

Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: Must meet McGill's admission and language requirements.
Eligibility Criteria.Field of Study: All undergraduate programs in the Faculty of Engineering.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Open to students entering their first year of an engineering program.

canada.Application Deadline: No separate application needed for the main entrance scholarships (MEDA - Major Entrance D'Arcy). Considered automatically upon admission.
canada.Value/Inclusions: Ranges from CAD 3,000 to CAD 12,000. Some are renewable for up to three years based on maintaining high academic standing.
canada.Application Process: Apply for admission to the Faculty of Engineering at McGill University. The top-ranking applicants are automatically offered a MEDA scholarship.

University Rankings.Note: A primarily undergraduate university, not typically featured in major global rankings.

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Based on admission average, calculated on high school courses required for the program. Tiered from 80% and up.
Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: Must meet MacEwan's English Language Proficiency requirements.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Must be an international student admitted to a program on a study permit.

canada.Application Deadline: No application required. Students are automatically considered based on their admission application.
canada.Value/Inclusions: Tiered based on admission average: 95%+: CAD 12,000; 90-94.9%: CAD 10,000; 85-89.9%: CAD 8,000; 80-84.9%: CAD 5,000.
canada.Application Process: Apply for admission to MacEwan University. Your application is automatically reviewed for scholarship eligibility. The award is based on your final, official high school transcript.

canada.Scholarship Name: Saint Mary's University (SMU) International Student Scholarships

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: An admission average of 80% or higher is required.
Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: Must meet SMU's English language requirements.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Open to international students entering directly from high school.

canada.Application Deadline: March 1 for most renewable scholarships. Some are automatic upon admission.
canada.Value/Inclusions: Ranges from CAD 1,000 to CAD 7,000 annually. Renewable based on maintaining a high GPA.
canada.Application Process: Apply for admission to Saint Mary's University. The admission application serves as the application for some scholarships. Major renewable awards require a separate application.

Required Documents.For specific awards: a separate application outlining leadership and extracurriculars.

canada.Scholarship Name: University of Guelph-Humber International Student Scholarship

University Rankings.Note: This is a unique partnership institution between the University of Guelph and Humber College. It is not ranked independently.

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Based on admission average, starting from 75%.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Must be an international student entering a university program for the first time.

canada.Application Deadline: No application required. Automatic consideration upon admission.
canada.Value/Inclusions: A one-time award, tiered based on admission average: 90%+: CAD 4,000; 85-89.9%: CAD 3,000; 80-84.9%: CAD 2,000; 75-79.9%: CAD 1,000.
canada.Application Process: Apply for admission to the University of Guelph-Humber. The award is granted based on your final high school grades.

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Based on academic merit, typically an 80%+ average.
Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: Must meet CBU's English language requirements.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Open to international students applying from high school.

canada.Application Deadline: Varies. Major awards have an early March deadline. Others are automatic.
canada.Value/Inclusions: Ranges from CAD 500 to CAD 5,000 per year. Some are renewable for a total value up to CAD 30,000.
canada.Application Process: Apply for admission to Cape Breton University. You are automatically considered for some awards. A separate application is needed for major scholarships.

Required Documents.For specific awards: an essay and letters of reference.

canada.Scholarship Name: Ontario Tech University Global Leadership Award

Eligibility Criteria.Other: Must be an international student demonstrating leadership in community service or extracurricular activities.

canada.Application Deadline: Mid-April.
canada.Value/Inclusions: CAD 72,000 (CAD 18,000 x 4 years).
canada.Application Process: Apply for admission to Ontario Tech University. Submit a separate application for the Global Leadership Award.

canada.Application Deadline: Automatically awarded. No application needed.
canada.Value/Inclusions: The Fanshawe College International India Applicant Scholarship is valued at CAD 1,000.
canada.Application Process: Apply for admission to Fanshawe College. Students from India are automatically considered upon acceptance.

canada.Scholarship Name: Mohawk College International Education Excellence Scholarships

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Awarded to the student with the highest GPA from their previous semester of study at Mohawk.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Must be a registered full-time international student.

canada.Application Deadline: Not applicable. Awarded automatically each semester.
canada.Application Process: Be enrolled as a full-time student at Mohawk College. The student with the top GPA in their program is automatically selected by the college.

canada.Scholarship Name: Douglas College International Student Entrance Scholarships

Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: Must meet Douglas College English requirements.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Must be an international student applying for admission.

canada.Application Deadline: Varies by semester (e.g., May 31 for Fall).
canada.Value/Inclusions: Up to CAD 7,000.

Eligibility Criteria.Other: Must be a new international student. This scholarship is not open to students in English for Academic Purposes (EAP) programs.

canada.Application Deadline: No application required. Based on country of citizenship.
canada.Application Process: Apply for admission to Algonquin College. Students from eligible countries (which historically includes India) are automatically assessed.

canada.Scholarship Name: Lethbridge College International Student Entrance Scholarship

Eligibility Criteria.Other: Must be an international student entering their first year.

canada.Application Deadline: Typically in the Spring for the following academic year.
canada.Value/Inclusions: Varies, typically around CAD 1,000.
canada.Application Process: Apply for admission to Lethbridge College. Apply for scholarships through the college's online awards portal.

canada.Scholarship Name: University of Calgary Graduate Award Competition

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Minimum GPA of 3.2, but competitive applicants often have 3.7 or higher.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Open to all prospective and current graduate students.

canada.Application Deadline: February 1. Students apply through an online portal.
canada.Value/Inclusions: A single application makes students eligible for dozens of awards with values ranging from CAD 1,000 to CAD 40,000.
canada.Application Process: Apply for admission to a graduate program at the University of Calgary. Complete the Graduate Award Competition application through the Student Centre portal.

canada.Host Country and University: Canada, available to students at any eligible Canadian institution.

Eligibility Criteria.Field of Study: All fields supported by the tri-agencies.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: This is a supplementary grant for CGS holders to conduct research outside of Canada for 3-6 months. An Indian student holding a CGS could use this to do research in another country.

canada.Application Deadline: Varies by institution, typically in May and September.
canada.Value/Inclusions: Up to CAD 6,000 to cover travel, accommodation, and other research-related expenses.
canada.Application Process: First, you must win a Canada Graduate Scholarship (e.g., CGS-M or CGS-D). Apply for the supplement through your university's graduate awards office.

canada.Host Country and University: Canada, at various participating universities in Ontario.

Eligibility Criteria.Other: Open to all students, including internationals.

canada.Application Deadline: Students must be nominated by their university. The university deadline is typically in late March.

canada.Application Process: Apply and be accepted into a recognized AI Master's program at an Ontario university (e.g., U of Toronto, Waterloo, Queen's). The university's department will nominate top candidates.

canada.Scholarship Name: Aga Khan Foundation International Scholarship Programme
canada.Host Country and University: Canada, and other select countries. Restricted to a few universities like McGill, U of T, U of Alberta.

Eligibility Criteria.Field of Study: Varies, but development-related fields are preferred.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Must be a citizen of a country where AKF has a local office, including India. Must be under 30 years of age. Based on financial need.

canada.Value/Inclusions: Covers tuition fees and living expenses. It is a 50% grant and 50% loan.
canada.Application Process: Obtain an application form from the Aga Khan Foundation office in your country of residence (India). Submit the completed application and supporting documents to the local office.

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Must meet the admission requirements for a full-time master's or professional program at McGill.
Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: As required by the McGill program.
Eligibility Criteria.Field of Study: Over 150 eligible programs across the university.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Based on exceptional character, community engagement, leadership potential, entrepreneurial spirit, and academic strength.

canada.Application Deadline: The deadline for international applicants is typically late August.
canada.Value/Inclusions: A fully funded award covering tuition and fees for the program, plus a living stipend of CAD 2,000 per month. Also includes a comprehensive leadership development program.
canada.Application Process: Complete the McCall MacBain Scholarship application online. If selected as a finalist, you will participate in interviews. You must also apply separately to an eligible program at McGill.

canada.Scholarship Name: University of Manitoba - India Centre for Academic, Business and Community Excellence Scholarship

Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: Must meet the University of Manitoba's English language requirements.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Specifically for students from India who demonstrate academic merit and community leadership.

canada.Application Deadline: Varies. Students should check the India Centre website and the university's awards database.
canada.Value/Inclusions: Varies, typically in the range of CAD 1,000 - CAD 5,000.
canada.Application Process: Apply for admission to the University of Manitoba. Search and apply for awards through the 'UM Award' database.

Required Documents.Specific scholarship application: which may require a statement on community involvement.

Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: N/A for the scholarship, but required for university admission.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Must have applied or be planning to apply to a university through a Studyportals website. Based on an essay.

canada.Application Deadline: Varies, check the website for current deadlines.
canada.Value/Inclusions: Varies, often up to €5,000.
canada.Application Process: Submit an application with a short essay on why you deserve the scholarship, along with a letter of acceptance from a university.

canada.Host Country and University: Canada, International Development Research Centre (IDRC) in Ottawa.
canada.Level of Study: Research position for recent graduates (Master's or PhD).

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Must have completed a Master's or PhD degree from a recognized university.
Eligibility Criteria.Field of Study: Fields related to international development (e.g., climate change, global health, sustainable food systems).
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Open to citizens of Canada, permanent residents, and citizens of low- and middle-income countries, including India.

canada.Application Deadline: The call for applications is typically announced annually, often in the spring.
canada.Value/Inclusions: This is a one-year paid research position at the IDRC. The salary is commensurate with experience, approximately CAD 49,000 - CAD 55,000.
canada.Application Process: Wait for the annual call for applications on the IDRC website. Submit a complete application online, including a cover letter and CV.

Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: As required by the host university.
Eligibility Criteria.Field of Study: Must align with one of Rotary's seven areas of focus (e.g., Peace and conflict prevention, Disease prevention, Water and sanitation, Maternal and child health, Basic education, Economic development, Environment).
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Must be sponsored by a local Rotary Club in your home district and a host club in Canada.

canada.Application Deadline: Varies. The application process must start with your local Rotary Club well in advance (up to a year) of your studies.
canada.Value/Inclusions: Minimum budget for a global grant scholarship is USD 30,000. This can fund graduate-level coursework or research for one to four academic years.
canada.Application Process: Contact your local Rotary Club to inquire about their scholarship sponsorship process. Identify a university and program in Canada that aligns with a Rotary area of focus. Develop a detailed study plan and budget. The local and host Rotary clubs submit the grant application to The Rotary Foundation.

europe.Host Country and University: France, at various French higher education institutions.

University Rankings.Note: Not applicable (multiple institutions). The scholarship is tenable at top French universities like PSL University (QS 2025: 24th) and Institut Polytechnique de Paris (QS 2025: 59th).

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Open to candidates with an outstanding academic record. Applications are submitted by French higher education institutions, not by the students themselves. [1, 2]
Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: Language proficiency requirements are determined by the host institution and the program of study. [1]
Eligibility Criteria.Field of Study: Master's level: Science and Technology, Humanities and Social Sciences. PhD level: Science and Technology, and Life Sciences. [1]
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Open to all international students. Candidates with dual nationality, one of which is French, are not eligible. [1]

europe.Application Deadline: The call for applications usually opens in October and closes in early January. Institutions have their own internal deadlines. [1]
europe.Value/Inclusions: For Master's students, a monthly allowance of €1,181. For PhD students, a monthly allowance of €1,700. The scholarship also covers international return travel, health insurance, and cultural activities. It does not cover tuition fees. [1]
europe.Application Process: Students must first gain admission to a Master's or PhD program at a French university. The university then decides whether to nominate the student for the Eiffel Scholarship. [1]

Required Documents.All documents required for university ad: The university uses these for the nomination.
Required Documents.Statement of Purpose (SOP): Often required by the university for admission.
Required Documents.Letters of Recommendation (LORs): Often required by the university for admission.

europe.How old the scholarship is: The program was established by the French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs in 1999. [2]
europe.Age limit: Up to 25 years old for Master's level and up to 30 years old for PhD level at the time of the application campaign. [1]

europe.Scholarship Name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships for Foreign Scholars and Artists
europe.Host Country and University: Switzerland, at all Swiss cantonal universities, universities of applied sciences, and the two federal institutes of technology. [3]

University Rankings.Note: Not applicable (multiple institutions). Key participating universities include ETH Zurich (QS 2025: 7th) and EPFL (QS 2025: 26th).

europe.Level of Study: Postgraduate (PhD, Postdoctoral, Research Fellowships) and Fine Arts (Master's). [3]

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: A Master's degree or equivalent for PhD applicants. A PhD degree for postdoctoral applicants. Must have a high level of academic achievement. [3]
Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: Language proficiency depends on the chosen study program (German, French, Italian, or English).
Eligibility Criteria.Field of Study: All academic fields are available for research, PhD, and postdoctoral scholarships. Arts scholarships are limited to students from countries with which Switzerland has a specific agreement. [3]
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Open to students from over 180 countries. A research proposal and a letter of acceptance from a host professor are crucial. [3]

europe.Application Deadline: Varies by country, but typically falls between September and December. Applications are submitted to the Swiss Embassy in the applicant's home country. [3]
europe.Value/Inclusions: A monthly stipend (CHF 1,920 for research and arts Master's; CHF 3,500 for postdoctoral), exemption from tuition fees, mandatory Swiss health insurance, a one-time lump sum for a flight ticket, and a special lodging allowance. [4]
europe.Application Process: Obtain the application package from the Swiss Embassy in your home country. Find a host professor at a Swiss university and get a letter of acceptance. Submit the completed application form and required documents to the Swiss Embassy. [3]

Required Documents.CV or Resume: With a list of academic publications. [3]
Required Documents.Research Proposal: A detailed research proposal is required for PhD and research tracks. [3]
Required Documents.Letters of Recommendation (LORs): Two confidential letters of recommendation from professors. [3]
Required Documents.Letter of Acceptance: A letter from an academic host professor at the chosen Swiss university is required. [3]

europe.How old the scholarship is: This is a long-standing program offered annually by the Swiss Confederation. [4]
europe.Age limit: No specific age limit, but PhD degree should not be older than three years for postdoc applicants. [3]

europe.Host Country and University: Netherlands, at various Dutch research universities and universities of applied sciences.

University Rankings.Note: Not applicable (multiple institutions). Key participating universities include TU Delft (QS 2025: 49th) and University of Amsterdam (QS 2025: 55th).

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Must meet the specific admission requirements of the chosen Dutch institution. [5]
Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: English proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL) is required as per the program's standards.
Eligibility Criteria.Field of Study: Varies by institution. Most fields of study are covered.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: For non-EEA international students who have not previously studied in the Netherlands. [5]

europe.Application Deadline: Typically February 1 or May 1. Students must check the specific deadline of their chosen institution. [5]
europe.Value/Inclusions: A one-time amount of €5,000 in the first year of studies. This is not a full tuition fee waiver but a contribution towards study costs. [5]
europe.Application Process: Apply for admission to a Bachelor's or Master's program at one of the participating Dutch universities. Concurrently, apply for the NL Scholarship directly at the institution. [5]

Required Documents.Motivation Letter: Often required for the scholarship application, detailing why you should be selected.
Required Documents.CV or Resume: May be required by the institution.

europe.How old the scholarship is: Established to promote the Netherlands as a study destination.

europe.Scholarship Name: Italian Government Scholarship for Foreign Students
europe.Host Country and University: Italy, at various Italian higher education institutions.

University Rankings.Note: Not applicable (multiple institutions). Key participating universities include Politecnico di Milano (QS 2025: 111th) and University of Bologna (QS 2025: 133rd).

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Requires a Bachelor's degree for Master's programs and a Master's degree for PhD programs. [7]
Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: For English-taught courses, a B2 level of English (IELTS/TOEFL) is required. For Italian-taught courses, a B2 level of Italian is needed. [7]
Eligibility Criteria.Field of Study: A wide range of programs offered at public Italian institutions.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Open to students from a specific list of eligible countries. [7]

europe.Application Deadline: The call for applications is usually published in the spring, with a deadline typically in June. [7]
europe.Value/Inclusions: Exemption from tuition fees, a monthly stipend of €900, and health and medical insurance for the duration of the grant. [7]
europe.Application Process: Apply online through the 'Study in Italy' portal. You do not need a prior letter of acceptance from the university to apply for the scholarship. [7]

Required Documents.Proof of Language Proficiency: Required for either English or Italian.

europe.How old the scholarship is: An annual scholarship program funded by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation (MAECI). [7]
europe.Age limit: Applicants for Master's Degree/Higher Education in Arts, Music, and Dance (AFAM) Programmes/ Italian Language and Culture advanced Courses should not be over 28 years old. For PhD Programmes, applicants should not be over 30. [7]

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Awarded to students with excellent academic credentials and a profile that matches the program. [6]
Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: Must meet the English or French language requirements for the chosen program.
Eligibility Criteria.Field of Study: All programs offered at Sciences Po.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: For non-European Union students who are first-time applicants. [6]

europe.Application Deadline: Undergraduate deadline is typically in late February, and the Master's deadline is in late November. [6]
europe.Value/Inclusions: Can range from a partial tuition grant of a few thousand euros to a full tuition waiver covering the entire duration of the program. For example, it can be €14,210 per year for the three years of the Bachelor's program or €13,000 per year for the two years of the Master's. [6]
europe.Application Process: Indicate your interest in the Emile Boutmy scholarship in the 'Financial Information' section of your Sciences Po application. There is no separate application form. [6]

Required Documents.Proof of income and financial situation: Documents detailing family income are required. [6]

europe.How old the scholarship is: Named after the founder of Sciences Po to attract top international students. [6]

europe.Scholarship Name: ETH Zurich Excellence Scholarship & Opportunity Programme (ESOP)

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Must have graduated with a Bachelor's degree from a university with excellent results (top 10% of your programme). [8]
Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: Must meet the English language requirements for the Master's program. GRE may be required.
Eligibility Criteria.Field of Study: All Master's degree programs offered at ETH Zurich.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Open to national and international students. A pre-proposal for your Master's thesis is a key part of the application. [8]

europe.Application Deadline: The application window is from November 1 to December 15, alongside the Master's program application. [8]
europe.Value/Inclusions: Covers the full study and living costs during the Master's degree. It includes a grant of CHF 12,000 per semester and a tuition fee waiver. [8]
europe.Application Process: Apply for a Master's program at ETH Zurich and complete the separate application for the ESOP scholarship through the eApply portal. [8]

Required Documents.Pre-proposal for Master's Thesis: A detailed proposal is a mandatory and critical part of the application. [8]

europe.How old the scholarship is: ETH Zurich's flagship scholarship for Master's students.

europe.Scholarship Name: Bocconi University Merit and International Awards

Eligibility Criteria.Academic Requirements: Awarded based on outstanding academic achievement. The primary factor is the candidate's performance in the admission test (Bocconi test, SAT, or ACT) and/or previous GPA. [9]
Eligibility Criteria.Standardized Test Scores: A strong performance in the SAT/ACT or the Bocconi online test is crucial for consideration. [9]
Eligibility Criteria.Field of Study: All Bachelor of Science and Master of Science programs offered at Bocconi.
Eligibility Criteria.Other: Open to both Italian and international applicants. [9]

europe.Application Deadline: No separate application is needed. You are automatically considered when you apply for admission to Bocconi by the specified deadlines (several rounds from January to April). [9]
europe.Value/Inclusions: The Merit Award includes a full tuition and fees waiver, worth up to approximately €14,000 per year. The Bocconi International Award offers a 50% tuition reduction. [9]
europe.Application Process: Complete and submit the application for admission to your chosen program at Bocconi University. The Admissions Committee will evaluate all candidates and grant the awards to the most meritorious students. [9]
